title: Đề 160 — Kế Toán Tài Chính Quốc Tế
description: Bộ câu hỏi ôn tập kế toán tài chính quốc tế (Mã đề 160).

questions.question: Titan Co acquired a controlling interest in Luna Ltd on 1 October 20X5. Luna Ltd's financial year ends on 31 December each year. For the full financial year ended 31 December 20X5, Luna Ltd reported a total profit after tax of $12,000. It is assumed that profits accrue evenly throughout the year. How much of the annual profit should be classified as pre-acquisition profit for the purpose of consolidated financial statements?
questions.explanation: Titan mua Luna ngày 1/10/20X5, tức chỉ nắm quyền kiểm soát 3 tháng cuối năm (Oct-Dec). Pre-acquisition = 9/12 × $12,000 = $9,000.

questions.question: Which of following situations indicates control even if a parent owns only 40% of the voting shares?
options: The parent has the power to appoint or remove a majority of the board of directors.
The subsidiary is located in the same country as the parent.
The parent and subsidiary share a similar brand name.
The parent receives a 40% dividend from the subsidiary.
questions.explanation: Có quyền bổ nhiệm hoặc bãi miễn đa số thành viên HĐQT là đủ để kiểm soát, bất kể tỷ lệ sở hữu cổ phần.

questions.question: Why is the analysis of accounting information considered to be of limited use on its own?
options: It provides objective data that automatically eliminates the need for managerial judgment.
It captures all qualitative aspects of a business, such as brand reputation and employee morale.
It just identifies symptoms of a company's performance, not the underlying causes.
It allows for the 100% accurate prediction of future market trends based on historical trends.
questions.explanation: Phân tích kế toán chỉ nhận diện triệu chứng, không giải thích nguyên nhân sâu xa của hiệu quả hoạt động.

questions.question: Which of the following is evidence that an investor has significant influence over an investee?
options: The investor provides a small, one-time loan to the investee.
The investor holds 5% of the shares and has no contact with management.
Representation on the board of directors of the investee.
The investor and investee are in completely different industries.
questions.explanation: Có đại diện trong HĐQT là bằng chứng rõ ràng nhất của significant influence theo IAS 28.

questions.question:
Vayron Co acquired 100% of the ordinary shares in Weeton Co and Yarlet Co some years ago. Extracts from the statements of financial position of the 3 companies as at 30 September 20X7 were as follows:
- Vayron retained earnings: $90,000
- Weeton retained earnings: $40,000
- Yarlet retained earnings: $70,000
At acquisition Weeton Co had retained losses of $10,000 and Yarlet Co had retained earnings of $30,000. What are the consolidated retained earnings on 30 September 20X7?
questions.explanation: Vayron RE = $90,000. Weeton post-acquisition = 40,000 - (-10,000) = $50,000 (vì tại ngày mua Weeton có retained LOSSES $10,000). Yarlet post-acquisition = 70,000 - 30,000 = $40,000. Consolidated RE = 90,000 + 50,000 + 40,000 = $180,000.

questions.question: What might a high asset turnover indicate if achieved by keeping prices very low?
options: That the company has too much inventory in the warehouse.
That the company has low profit margin on sales.
That the company is operating in a luxury, low-volume market.
That the capital employed is too high.
questions.explanation: Giá thấp → doanh thu lớn → asset turnover cao, nhưng biên lợi nhuận thấp. ROCE = Profit Margin × Asset Turnover, nên asset turnover cao chưa chắc ROCE tốt.

questions.question: Why are bare figures in financial statements considered not particularly useful on their own?
options: Significance can only be established through comparisons with other relevant information or ratios.
They are always rounded to the nearest thousand, making them inaccurate.
They are only intended for use by the government tax authorities and key suppliers.
They do not include the risk associated with the company operation.
questions.explanation: Con số đơn lẻ chỉ có ý nghĩa khi được so sánh với thông tin khác hoặc tỷ số — không có ngữ cảnh thì không thể đánh giá tốt hay xấu.

questions.question:
A company reported the following year-end data:
- Cost of Sales: $145,000
- Opening Inventory: $12,000
- Closing Inventory: $15,000
- Trade Payables: $16,500
- Cash Purchases: $20,000
What is the accounts payable payment period for the credit purchases made during the year (using 365 days)?
options: 47 days
39 days
42 days
50 days
questions.explanation: Credit purchases = CoS + Closing inventory - Opening inventory - Cash purchases = 145,000 + 15,000 - 12,000 - 20,000 = $128,000. AP days = (16,500 / 128,000) × 365 = 47 days.

questions.question: What is the fundamental principle of consolidation?
options: Listing all subsidiaries in the parent's notes without changing the balance sheet.
Adding the profits of two companies and dividing them by two.
Combining only the assets of companies that operate in the same industry.
Presenting the results, assets, and liabilities of a group as if they were a single company.
questions.explanation: Nguyên tắc cơ bản của hợp nhất là trình bày kết quả, tài sản và nợ phải trả của cả tập đoàn như thể là một công ty duy nhất.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of using accounting ratios when analysing financial statements?
options: To summarise and present financial information in a more understandable form through comparison.
To replace the need for a Statement of Financial Position entirely.
To hide sensitive financial data from the company's competitors.
To guarantee that a company will be profitable in the next financial year.
questions.explanation: Mục đích chính của tỷ số kế toán là tóm tắt và trình bày thông tin tài chính dễ hiểu hơn thông qua so sánh.

questions.question:
On 1/1/20X9, Kappa acquired 100% ordinary shares of Lamda at a total cost of $1,000,000. At this date, Lamda's financial position is measured at fair value and at following:
- Ordinary share capital: $800,000
- Retained earnings: $250,000
Which of the following is correct?
options: NCI is $50,000
Loss on business combination is $50,000
Goodwill is $50,000
Gain from a bargain purchase is $50,000
questions.explanation: Net assets = 800,000 + 250,000 = $1,050,000. Consideration = $1,000,000. Vì consideration < net assets → Gain from bargain purchase = $50,000. Không có NCI vì mua 100%.

questions.question:
Harbor Co acquired a 60% equity interest in Sterling Ltd on 1 July 20X4 (exactly mid-year). Both companies have a financial year ending 31 December 20X4. The following information is available as of 31 December 20X4:
- Harbor Co: Individual retained earnings are $500,000.
- Sterling Ltd: Retained earnings were $100,000 on 1 January 20X4 and grew to $160,000 by 31 December 20X4. Profits are assumed to have accrued evenly.
- During 20X4, Sterling Ltd (the subsidiary) sold goods to Harbor Co. At the year-end, the inventory of Harbor Co still included an unrealised profit of $10,000 from these sales.
Calculate the consolidated retained earnings to be presented in the Harbor Group's Statement of Financial Position as of 31 December 20X4.
questions.explanation: Post-acquisition profit Sterling = 60,000 × 6/12 = $30,000. Harbor share = 60% × 30,000 = $18,000. Subsidiary là seller → Group RE chịu 60% × 10,000 = $6,000. Consolidated RE = 500,000 + 18,000 - 6,000 = $512,000.

questions.question: If revenue is $100,000 and cost of sales is $55,000, what is the gross profit margin?
P Co buys 100% of S Co for $80,000. At acquisition, S Co has $50,000 share capital and $10,000 retained earnings. What is the goodwill?
Consolidated financial statements are prepared based on which accounting concept?
options: Substance over form
Historical cost
Materiality
Prudence
questions.explanation: Báo cáo hợp nhất dựa trên nguyên tắc Substance over form — nhìn vào bản chất kinh tế (tập đoàn là một thực thể) hơn là hình thức pháp lý (nhiều công ty riêng lẻ).

questions.question: How does a successful rights issue of shares affect a company's gearing (the ratio of debt to equity)?
options: It has no effect on gearing.
It makes the company 100% debt-funded.
It increases gearing.
It decreases gearing.
questions.explanation: Phát hành thêm cổ phiếu làm tăng equity → gearing (Debt/Equity) giảm.

questions.question: How does diversification impair the comparability between companies?
options: It makes the calculation of the current ratio impossible.
Diversification makes the company more profitable automatically.
A company involved in many industries is hard to compare against a specialist company.
Diversified companies are not required to publish financial statements.
questions.explanation: Công ty hoạt động nhiều ngành khó so sánh với công ty chuyên ngành vì cơ cấu tỷ số tài chính khác nhau hoàn toàn.

questions.question: How is an investment in an associate shown in the investor's statement of financial position?
options: It is hidden within the "Goodwill" account.
By adding the associate's buildings and cash to the group's assets.
As a single line item under non-current assets called "Investment in associate".
As a current liability until the associate pays a dividend.
questions.explanation: Theo IAS 28, khoản đầu tư vào công ty liên kết được trình bày là một dòng mục riêng trong Non-current assets: Investment in associate.

questions.question:
On 1 January 20X7, Parent Co acquired 90% of the equity share capital of Sub Co. At the date of acquisition, the fair value of the Non-controlling Interest (NCI) was $15,000. For the financial year ended 31 December 20X7, the following information is available:
- Sub Co reported a profit for the year of $50,000.
- During the year, Parent Co sold goods to Sub Co. At year-end, the inventory of Sub Co included an unrealised profit of $10,000 from this intra-group transaction.
What is the value of the NCI to be presented in the Consolidated Statement of Financial Position as of 31 December 20X7?
questions.explanation: NCI tại ngày mua = $15,000. NCI share of profit = 10% × $50,000 = $5,000. Parent là seller → unrealised profit 100% trừ vào Group RE, NCI không bị ảnh hưởng. NCI = 15,000 + 5,000 = $20,000.

questions.question: What is a major information problem when using published financial statements for ratio analysis?
options: The base information is often out of date, leading to problems of interpretation.
The figures are written in a manner that only auditors can understand.
The information is updated every hour, making it too fast to track.
Published accounts are only available to the company's directors.
questions.explanation: Báo cáo tài chính công bố thường là thông tin cũ, gây khó khăn cho việc phân tích và đánh giá tình hình hiện tại.
